text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear thesis in the opening sentence","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"It states a direct position up front and previews the main reasons that will support it."},{"evidence":"three developed body paragraphs","quality":"organization","description":"It is structured into a clear introduction, body, and conclusion with separate paragraphs for each main point."},{"evidence":"uses article evidence about half a million crash-free miles","quality":"textual support","description":"It grounds its claims in relevant details from the source instead of relying mostly on opinion."},{"evidence":"explains how driverless cars could reduce human error","quality":"reasoning depth","description":"It does more than assert a point by connecting the evidence to a broader explanation of why the technology would help."},{"evidence":"extended discussion of leisure and entertainment","quality":"idea development","description":"It develops one supporting reason with more elaboration and examples rather than just mentioning it briefly."},{"evidence":"formal tone and academic phrasing","quality":"style control","description":"It uses a more consistently essay-like voice with fewer casual abbreviations and conversational remarks."}]}
